text:
Aisha Khan: Quick heads up — I'm about to push a proactive customer RCA + enablement email for the onboarding wave impacted by yesterday's ingest timeouts. Draft in ~30m, want review and signoff for high-touch accounts. Main items to cover: outage window, what failed (bulk ingest queue), mitigation applied, next steps (backfill + manual retry), credits, and invite to office hours.

Marcos Rivera: Thanks — can you add the specific SLA lines (what we consider impacted vs degraded) and a short note on how credits are calculated? Also recommend a one-line apology at the top.

Lena Chen: Add SRE blurb: root cause was a malformed protobuf that caused the ingest worker to spin with retries -> queue backlog. We mitigated with a schema validation gate and rate-limited replay. If you want I can paste the short RCA sentence.

Aisha Khan: Please paste the one-liner SRE: that helps. Also include the timestamp window: 2026-03-22 03:10–03:48 UTC.

Lena Chen: SRE (short): "Root cause: a malformed protobuf message bypassed our schema checks, causing the ingest worker to retry downstream services and back up queues. We deployed a validation gate and rate limit to restore steady state."

Jae Park: Suggest we flag renewal-risk customers (>$5k ARR, onboarding stage) for 1:1 outreach; include an offer for a complimentary enablement session and 1 month of waived ingestion overage fees. I'll compile the list and drop it here in 15m.

Aisha Khan: Perfect — will add that to the email: "If you were in onboarding and have any disruption, we'll schedule a dedicated enablement session + offer a credit for ingestion overages during the outage window."

Support Bot: IncidentBot: Incident #2026-INGEST-874 resolved. Detect: 2026-03-22T03:10:12Z. Resolved: 2026-03-22T03:48:09Z. Postmortem draft created: https://redwood-internal/pg/INGEST-874/postmortem

Marcos Rivera: For the customer-facing text, keep it short and concrete. Example opener: "We’re sorry — on March 22 at ~03:10 UTC some onboarding ingestion jobs were delayed. We’ve fixed the root cause and completed replays; here’s what we did and how we’ll help." Then bullets for impact, mitigation, next steps, credits, contact.

Aisha Khan: Draft email copy below — please suggest edits by EOD. I'll send to high-touch list first and then a one-off broadcast to the rest of affected tenants.

Aisha Khan: "Hi {{first_name}},
We're sorry — on March 22 at 03:10–03:48 UTC some onboarding ingestion jobs for a subset of customers were delayed due to a malformed message in our pipeline. We’ve fixed the issue, completed backfills for critical onboarding flows, and applied safeguards to prevent recurrence. What we did: 
• Identified and blocked malformed protobufs at schema validation.
• Rate-limited replays to avoid downstream spikes.
• Completed backfill for primary onboarding queues; if you still see missing records open a ticket and we'll prioritize.
What you can expect: 
• We’ll schedule a dedicated enablement office hour for affected onboarding customers (link below).
• Applicable ingestion overage fees for the outage window will be waived; high-touch customers will get a one-month credit applied to invoices.
• Attachments: technical RCA (internal link) and a short FAQ.
If you’d like a 1:1 walkthrough, reply and we’ll set it up.
Sincerely,
Aisha Khan, Customer Success
"

Lena Chen: LGTM. Add a line: "We’ve also added message schema checks to the pipeline to reject malformed messages earlier."

Jae Park: I uploaded the high-touch list to the thread: https://redwood-internal/drive/high-touch-onboard-3-22.csv. Please use this for targeted outreach.

Aisha Khan: Added line and the high-touch list. Final ask: Marcos, can you approve credit wording?

Marcos Rivera: Approve. Suggested credit phrasing: "We will apply a credit equivalent to ingestion overage charges incurred during the outage window. For high-touch customers, we'll provide an additional one-month credit for platform usage."

Aisha Khan: Great — final plan: send targeted emails in 30m, host two office hours (APAC + EMEA/AMER slots), post public status + attach brief RCA. I'll file the customer copies in the incident page and ping sales for renewal follow-ups. Thanks team :heart:

Support Bot: DeployBot: Enabled schema-validation gate at 2026-03-22T04:05:22Z. Playbook step complete.
